findings.correction: When no address succeeded, a definitive name-wide NXDOMAIN takes precedence over an earlier transient family error.
findings.proof: The owned UDP peer returns SERVFAIL for A and NXDOMAIN with SOA for AAAA. Both the live Any lookup and its immediate cached repeat return NameNotFound; only the live error identifies the responding server.

findings.correction: Map all ResolveException paths during post-query response interpretation with the selected responding nameserver and the existing context-aware error mapper. This includes unsupported RCODEs and CNAME interpretation failures, rather than special-casing FORMERR.
findings.proof: A new FORMERR regression and the extended conflicting-CNAME regression both failed endpoint checks before correction and pass afterward.
